decision_conditions: The works approved by this Listed Building Consent must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this decision notice. Reason: To comply with S.51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and document:Location Plan - RM-LO-001-A Rev. ABlock Plan - RM-EXSI-002-A Rev. AProposed Floor Plan - RM-PRPL-003-A Rev. AProposed First Floor Plan - RM-PRPL-005-A Rev. AProp. Section AA Plan - RM-PRSE-007-A Rev. ADesign and Access Statement	Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to the commencement of works and notwithstanding the approved drawings, revised drawings at a scale of between 1:1 and 1:20 showing all junctions with the existing structure (walls, floors, windows and architectural details) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These shall demonstrate how existing finishes will be safeguarded (including throughout construction) and demonstrate that the works are fully reversible. Works shall be completed in accordance with the revised plans and permanently maintained as such.Reason: To safeguard the character, appearance and historic fabric of the Grade II listed building in accordance with policy DMD44 of the Development Management Document (2014), policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) as well as the NPPF (2024).

Prior to the commencement of works and notwithstanding the approved drawings, revised drawings of columns, beams, stairs and railings at a scale of between 1:1 and 1:50 shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These shall demonstrate a high-quality architectural intervention. Works shall be completed in accordance with the revised plans and permanently maintained as such.Reason: To safeguard the character, appearance and historic fabric of the Grade II listed building in accordance with policy DMD44 of the Development Management Document (2014), policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) as well as the NPPF (2024).
